assertions.name: candidates_evaluated
assertions.source: Six candidate Hecke words for β_loop evaluated at q_0; ratios to α/(4π) computed for transparency. NOT a derivation claim — see witness for explicit open gaps.

description: Scaffold for the Reshetikhin-Turaev shadow-world 2-loop self-energy derivation of α/(4π). This is the framework's endorsed path per prop:em-coupling-bring-zero-mode after the depth-search refutation chain (B_2/B_3/B_4 PSLQ all PARTIAL, fit-class refuted). Computes tr_M for several candidate Hecke words representing the categorical fermion loop on the photon line, identifies the OPEN gap (no canonical β_loop identification in the framework yet), and documents the next R&D steps. Honest scaffold; no claim of a derivation.

beta_loop_candidates.name: σ_1² on H_2
beta_loop_candidates.rationale: Double-crossing bubble (canonical fermion loop in topological QFT).

beta_loop_candidates.name: h·σ_1 + 1 (Hecke quadratic identity)
beta_loop_candidates.rationale: Hecke relation σ_1² = h·σ_1 + 1; expansion of (2) in the canonical basis.

beta_loop_candidates.name: (tr_M(σ_1) / tr_M(photon)) · 1/(4π)
beta_loop_candidates.rationale: Direct polarization-amplitude ansatz: fermion-loop trace over photon trace, times the universal 1/(4π) QED factor.

beta_loop_candidates.name: (tr_M(σ_1²) / tr_M(photon)) · 1/(4π)
beta_loop_candidates.rationale: Bubble-loop variant: σ_1² is the genuine closed fermion loop in the categorical diagram.

closest_candidate.name: (tr_M(σ_1²) / tr_M(photon)) · 1/(4π)
closest_candidate.honest_caveat: Matching by ratio is NOT a derivation — the fit-class trap warned against in the proposition. This scaffold's purpose is to make the OPEN gaps explicit, not to claim a match.

open_gaps: (i)   No canonical β_loop identification: which Hecke word represents the categorical fermion loop on the photon line? Six candidates listed above; none has been derived from the QOU categorical Lagrangian.

(ii)  No formal RT shadow-world UV regularization argument: the assertion that the categorical self-energy is FINITE (no log Λ² divergence) requires explicit shadow-world calculation — only stated as a roadmap item in the deprecated alpha-em-correction-derivation-attempts witness.

(iii) No structural normalization: the factor 1/(4π) outside the Hecke trace should come from the Bring-area Hodge data (analogous to the leading 2/(3π) term coming from dim H¹/Area). The framework's leading-term identification (2/(3π) = Vol(S²)/(3·Vol(S³))) does NOT yet have a next-order partner identified.
(iv)  No 2-loop diagram in the Lean formalization: the predicted-spectra/em-coupling-bring-zero-mode.lean file axiomatises the Bring zero-mode shift but has no 2-loop self-energy structure.
